answer: Agents stake collateral in a shared mirror ledger whose per-epoch state root commits to hardware-attested telemetry, so each identity maps to one physical guidance bus rather than a cheap keypair. Colluders attempting a sybil spiral must replicate that attested sensor stream across a tundra of isolated replicas, and divergence between any replica and the canonical boundary layer. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
